why_absent: The installed national normal uses ERA5 reanalysis; no retained PAGASA station/gauge extract was available for a country-weighted 1991-2020 reconstruction.

why_absent: The retained evidence is a normalized compilation with exact API URLs and values, but original response files and their download-time hashes were not preserved.
upgrade_source: Re-download each exact endpoint, store raw JSON responses and response headers, and record one SHA-256 per response in SOURCES.csv.

item: Environmental-flow-adjusted surface availability
why_absent: The 125.79 km3/year figure is national surface-water potential, not dependable yield after environmental-flow reservation, storage, seasonality and conveyance losses.
upgrade_source: National/basin dependable-yield studies, environmental-flow requirements, reservoir operating rules and observed allocation/withdrawal data.
notes: The installed UCC is explicitly a sensitivity ceiling.

item: Aquifer stock, head and safe yield
why_absent: The 20.2 km3/year figure is national potential flow. The model has no aquifer polygons, initial head, saturated thickness, area, storage coefficient, natural discharge or admissible drawdown.
upgrade_source: Aquifer-resolved hydrogeology and observed head series crosswalked to demand and recharge nodes; add a formulation that carries groundwater state between years.
notes: No groundwater stock or depletion claim is made.

item: Seasonal and interannual water scarcity
why_absent: The installed annual median path cannot represent dry-season stress, typhoon sequencing, El Nino/La Nina variability or storage carryover.
upgrade_source: PAGASA seasonal rainfall, basin runoff/recharge models, reservoir storage and seasonal demand/withdrawal data.
notes: CCKP seasonal anomalies are retained as context but not installed.

why_absent: Inherited pumping-electricity links are retained, but groundwater lift, pumping efficiency, source depth and public/power pumping costs are not calibrated.
upgrade_source: NWRB permits/well records, utility production and energy records, groundwater levels and pump efficiencies by source.
notes: The water link is physical 1:1; it does not determine the least-cost source split credibly.

why_absent: The PSA 218.46 bcm abstraction includes large non-consumptive hydropower, while the policy-note current-use figure and model withdrawals use different boundaries.
upgrade_source: Reconcile NWRB permits, PSA physical water accounts, NIA irrigation diversions, MWSS/LWUA/utility production, industrial self-supply and hydropower return flows.
notes: No observed source or sector share is calibrated in v15.

priority: low for national model; high for spatial rebuild
notes: The whole-country model does not require this artifact.

upgrade_source: Hydrogeologic water balances, baseflow separation, spring inventories and ecosystem flow requirements by aquifer/basin.
notes: The groundwater ceiling is not safe yield.

why_absent: Only unit-matched 2020 national achieved yields are frozen; GAEZ supplies attainable potential rather than observed achieved yield by cluster.
upgrade_source: Freeze PSA regional production and exactly matched area definitions by crop and water regime then calculate cluster-compatible achieved coefficients.

why_absent: Uniform national yields leave cluster choice endogenous against heterogeneous inherited crop-water coefficients; the repair materially changes irrigated-rice water use even though its national area is unchanged.
upgrade_source: Reconcile subnational crop area irrigation source and crop-water requirement observations to the eight cluster definitions.

why_absent: Annual harvested area is the best available unit-matched proxy for rainfed annual crops but may count the same physical hectare more than once.
upgrade_source: Combine PSA harvested area with crop-specific cropping-intensity or physical planted-area evidence compatible with model land stocks.

why_absent: The existing aggregate commodities are retained and their 2020 aggregate yield bases are corrected but changing component mix is not represented.
upgrade_source: Add component commodities and technologies only in a separately scoped structural extension supported by component demand area cost water and emissions data.

why_absent: National AQUASTAT comparisons do not identify crop, season, conveyance-system or regional efficiency and the current 2020 4250/4260 pair crosses agricultural and irrigation-only boundaries.

notes: AQUASTAT is retained as a benchmark only; this provenance update does not install or change an efficiency coefficient.
